tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Page. Neutrals are near-black with only a whisper of violet; never #000, never warm. Read through bg-base.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Card, panel, input. Read through surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Raised: modal, popover, palette. Read through surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Inset: log wells, table heads, disabled fields. Read through surface-inset.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Hover. Read through surface-hover.

tokens.name: line-500
tokens.usage: Every structural hairline. Read through border-default.

tokens.name: line-400
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover. Read through border-strong.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Primary text value. Read through text-primary.

tokens.name: paper-400
tokens.usage: Muted text value. Read through text-muted.

tokens.name: paper-500
tokens.usage: Faint text value. Read through text-faint.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: The accent — the only saturated colour in the system. Read through accent.

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: Accent hover. Read through accent-hover.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: Accent press. Read through accent-active.

tokens.name: violet-200
tokens.usage: Accent glow and links. Read through accent-glow and text-link.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Status, desaturated and calm. Read through status-live.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Status, desaturated and calm. Read through status-warning.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Status, desaturated and calm. Read through status-failed.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: The page. Always. Nothing else goes this dark.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs on the page

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Only what floats: modal, popover, palette

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Wells: logs, table heads, disabled fields

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, nav items, secondary controls

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected / active fill: accent at 10% over the surface (was color-mix(in oklab, violet-500 10%, transparent)).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Values, titles, the thing being read. On every surface (16:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, descriptions, secondary values. On every surface (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Column heads, timestamps, placeholders. Source value kept: 3.2–3.5:1 on the surfaces, below 4.5:1 for 12–13px text.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (the primary button). Source value kept: 4.4:1 on accent, 3.5:1 on accent-hover, below 4.5:1 for 14px text.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links, on every surface (8.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link on hover.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Every structural hairline, and map linework

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover only

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Border of the focused control. Focus only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (4.3:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, active state, focus, nodes

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Primary button on press — press darkens, never shrinks.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Active / selected tint (was color-mix(in oklab, violet-500 10%, transparent)).

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Node glow and links. Never a drop shadow.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Live: badge text and dot, on status-live-bg (6.2:1).

tokens.name: status-live-bg
tokens.usage: Live badge fill: a 12% tint.

tokens.name: status-building
tokens.usage: Building: the one status that borrows the accent. Badge text and dot on status-building-bg — source value kept, 4.1:1 there, below 4.5:1 for 12px text.

tokens.name: status-building-bg
tokens.usage: Building badge fill: a 12% tint.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Queued: provisioned, not yet serving. Badge text and dot on status-queued-bg (5.2:1).

tokens.name: status-queued-bg
tokens.usage: Queued badge fill: a 10% tint.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Degraded / warning: badge text and dot on status-warning-bg (8.3:1).

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning badge fill: a 12% tint.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed: unreachable or build failed. Badge text and dot on status-failed-bg (5.2:1). Live and failed are told apart by hue alone (1.2:1), so every status always carries its word.

tokens.name: status-failed-bg
tokens.usage: Failed badge fill: a 12% tint.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim — flat, no blur.

styles.name: hero-metric
styles.usage: Hero metrics only. 700 lives here alone.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body and buttons. 500 is the default UI weight; 400 only for helper and long-form text.

styles.name: dense
styles.usage: Dense UI: nav, table cells, inputs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meta, table column heads, badge text. Uppercase only for 12px field labels and column heads.

styles.name: mono-value
styles.usage: Every technical value: hashes, domains, keys, IDs, regions.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Log lines and trailing metadata. Mono never drops below 12px.

styles.name: mono-metric
styles.usage: Hero counts set in mono (node count).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Only for icon-to-label gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The 8px base grid.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 8px grid step.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; card header-to-body gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card header padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 8px grid step.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: 8px grid step.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 8px grid step.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Control height, small.

tokens.name: control-h-md
tokens.usage: Control height — md is the default.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Control height, large.

tokens.name: control-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside controls and cells

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table row height

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Persistent left sidebar. Never collapses to a top nav.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Content column cap

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page padding and the gap between panels

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every container and control.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inline chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Only what is genuinely raised: modal, palette. A lifted top edge plus a deep, wide cast — on near-black a plain blur is invisible.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and dropdowns.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Primary button hover only — a soft spread, never a hard drop shadow (was color-mix tints of violet-200 24% and violet-500 55%).

tokens.name: glow-node
tokens.usage: Faint halo on map nodes (was color-mix of violet-200 45%).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px accent at 55%, on :focus-visible. Inputs do not glow.
